items.title: Gilead to pay $1.3B upfront for PepStar’s oral IL-23 challenger to J&J’s Icotyde
items.description: Gilead has struck a deal to acquire PepStar Therapeutics’ oral IL-23 receptor inhibitor program for $1.275 billion, positioning itself as a would-be challenger to Johnson & Johnson’s Icotyde across a range of inflammatory diseases.

items.title: ESMO: Boehringer builds case for late-phase rival to Amgen’s Imdelltra
items.description: Boehringer Ingelheim has shared data on its DLL3xCD3 T-cell engager, providing pointers to the prospects of a would-be rival to Amgen’s Imdelltra that entered phase 3 this year.

items.title: Bolt makes inflammation play with Prana reverse merger, $120M financing
items.description: Bolt Biotherapeutics is acquiring Prana Therapies in a stock-for-stock reverse merger backed by a $120 million financing to advance Prana’s lead antibody through multiple phase 2 trials in inflammatory diseases.

items.title: ESMO: Zentalis already dreaming of launch for WEE1 inhibitor after ‘great result’ in early-stage test
items.description: Zentalis Pharmaceuticals has pointed to the first overall survival (OS) analysis for azenosertib as proof that the oral WEE1 tyrosine kinase inhibitor can offer a convenient oral treatment for a tricky cancer.

items.title: ESMO: Takeda’s $1.2B bet on Innovent ‘absolutely’ pays off with details of ADC’s phase 3 win
items.description: Takeda has lifted the lid on the phase 3 win for its next-generation claudin18.2 drug, with the antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) demonstrating overall survival of 10.2 months.

items.title: Chutes & Ladders—Troubled CSL enlists GSK vet Deborah Waterhouse to lead
items.description: CSL has tapped a new leader to steer it through a make-or-break period. Ironwood's CEO since 2021 is hanging up his hat. CytoDyn's new helmsman is highlighting the company's "transformational period." And more.

items.title: BMS leads Pathos AI's $237M series E alongside Alzheimer's link-up
items.description: Pathos AI has closed a $237 million series E round led by pharma giant Bristol Myers Squibb on the same day that the two companies signed a cutting-edge Alzheimer's disease-focused collaboration.

items.title: Roche pays Zymeworks $55M for trispecific challenger to Amgen’s Imdelltra
items.description: Roche is paying Zymeworks $55 million upfront for ZW209, bagging global rights to a trispecific designed to improve on the rate and depth of responses achieved by Amgen’s Imdelltra.
